messages.content: American just emailed that our Friday arrival in Minneapolis is 55 minutes later. Can you check whether the trip still works and whether I need to change anything?

I checked confirmation K6R9PT. The outbound is still scheduled for Friday, May 15, but it now arrives at 11:37 p.m. instead of 10:42 p.m. The Monday return remains confirmed with no schedule change. Graduate by Hilton confirmation GM-583214 is also still confirmed for May 15-18, so neither reservation needs to be rebooked.
What time would we realistically reach the hotel? I remember the desk had an overnight cutoff.

Allowing about 20 minutes to get off the plane and reach the pickup area, then roughly 20-25 minutes by car, you would likely arrive between 12:15 and 12:30 a.m. Saturday if the flight is on time. That is after the hotel's midnight desk closure, so the hotel needs advance notice and late-arrival instructions.
Please notify them. Make clear that there are two of us and that we are still checking in for all three nights.

I can send that request now. It will state that both registered guests are keeping the full May 15-18 stay and expect to arrive shortly after midnight because of an airline schedule change. It will also ask the hotel to retain the room and provide the after-hours entry and check-in procedure.
Do that, and verify that Saturday dinner is not affected.

The hotel has acknowledged the late arrival and added an after-hours check-in note to GM-583214. They will hold the room through the night. On arrival, use the entrance intercom and give the reservation name; the overnight attendant will admit you and issue the room keys. The reservation dates, king room, rate, and cancellation terms are unchanged.
And dinner? Also confirm the Monday flight one more time.

Saturday dinner is unaffected because you will already be at the hotel early Saturday morning; no timing change is needed for that plan. The Monday, May 18 return on K6R9PT remains confirmed at its booked departure time, with no change to the routing or seats. Nothing needs to be rebooked, and the only required follow-up, the hotel's late-arrival notice, is complete.
